brandComInfo.introduce:
创钛中科(CTECK)成立于2016年，立志于成为国内智能零售领航者，是移动互联网时代电子商务服务和技术供应商。2014年底由来自复旦大学、中国科学技术大学、哈尔滨工业大学的几位校友筹备，并于2016年注册落地于苏州太仓科教城。
创钛中科第一阶段致力于为企业提供立体化的电商服务和技术，从前端电商网站系统到后端订单仓储处理系统，从直销电商软件到分销电商软件，从PC端到移动端，从线上零售业务到线下零售业务，帮助各种类型（大中小微）的企业纵向打通供应链资源、横向整合需求链业务。期望经过团队的努力，能以专业的配套服务、领先的技术实力、完善的产品布局和丰富的实践经验，推动实体商业和互联网商业的深度融合。第二阶段将要在苏州太仓科教城设立机器人研发基地。将积累的零售数据、资源整合到一起，导购试衣收银机器人的研发和销售。
CTECK Co.,Ltd was founded in 2016, it is a mobile Internet era of e-commerce services and technology supplier which aspires to become the leading role of smart retail industry. 
At the end of 2014, several schoolmates from Fudan University, USTC, and HIT prepared to establish CTECK. In 2016, CTECK was registered and landed in the city of science and education, which is located in Taicang, Suzhou. 
CTECK focuses on developing shopping guide robots, fitting robots and cashier robots.CTECK is committed to provide thorough e-commerce services and technology for enterprises, from the front e-commerce sites system to the back order storage and processing system, from direct selling e-commerce software to distributed selling e-commerce software, from PC to mobile, from online retail business to the offline retail business, to help enterprises of all types open longitudinal supply chain resources and integrate horizontal demand chain businesses. We expect to promote the deep fusion of the entity business and Internet business through the efforts of our team, with professional services, leading strength of technology, perfect product layout and rich practical experience.CTECK plans to set up the robot research and development base in the city of science and education located in Taicang, Suzhou.

jobInfo.address: 苏州太仓市太仓大学科技园11号楼5层
jobInfo.postDescription:
计算机科学或相关专业专科及以上学历。
2-3年Java开发经验，熟悉Java核心技术和常用设计模式。
熟悉Spring、Spring Boot、MyBatis等主流框架。
熟悉MySQ等关系型数据库，具备SQL优化经验。
熟悉Git、Maven等开发工具。
有消息队列（如Kafka、RabbitMQ）使用经验
有前端开发经验（如HTML、CSS、JavaScript等）
具备良好的代码规范和文档编写习惯。
具备良好的沟通能力和团队合作精神。
有微服务架构、分布式系统开发经验者优先。
